api_key.description: The API Key to authenticate in the Hoop Gateway. May also be provided via `HOOP_APIKEY` environment variable.

api_url.description: The API URL of the Hoop Gateway instance. It may also be provided via `HOOP_APIURL` environment variable.

block.description: The Hoop provider allows managing resources from a Hoop Gateway instance API.

access_mode_connect.description: Enables or disables access native access when interacting with the connection. Accept values are `enabled` or `disabled`.

access_mode_exec.description: Enables or disables access to execute one off commands for the connection. Accept values are `enabled` or `disabled`.

access_mode_runbooks.description: Enables or disables access to runbooks for the connection. Accept values are `enabled` or `disabled`.

access_schema.description: Enables or disables displaying the introspection schema tree of database type connections. Accept values are `enabled` or `disabled`

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent associated with the connection.

command.description: The command entrypoint that will be executed for one off executions. Each command argument should be a separate entry in the list.

guardrail_rules.description: A list of guardrail rule ids to be applied to the connection.

id.description: The unique identifier of the connection resource.

jira_issue_template_id.description: The ID of the Jira issue template to be used for the connection.

name.description: The name of the connection resource.

redact_types.description: A list of redact types, these values are dependent of which DLP provider is being used.

reviewers.description: A list of approver groups that are allowed to approve a session.

secrets.description: A map of secrets to be used by the connection. The key must have the prefix `envvar:KEY_NAME` or `filesystem:KEY_NAME`. These prefixes indicate how the secret will be used on runtime.

subtype.description: The subtype of the connection resource.

tags.description: A map of tags to be associated with the connection.

type.description: The type of the connection resource. Valid values are `database`, `application`, or `custom`.

block.description: Manage a connection resource in Hoop Platform.

connection_ids.description: List of connection IDs which this rule applies to.

deny_list.description: List of words to be returned as PII if found.

name.description: The name of the custom entity type as uppercase.

regex.description: The regex pattern to match (python) the custom entity type.

score.description: Detection confidence of this pattern (0.01 if very noisy, 0.6-1.0 if very specific)

custom_entity_types.description: The custom entity types that this rule applies to.

description.description: The description of the data masking rule.

id.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

name.description: The unique name of the data masking rule.

score_threshold.description: The minimal detection score threshold for the entities to be masked.

entity_types.description: The registered entity types in the redact provider.

name.description: An identifier for this structure, it's used as an identifier of a collection of entities.

config.description: A map of generic configuration required for this plugin.

id.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

plugin_name.description: The name of the plugin that this configuration refers to. Accepted values are: `slack`, and `runbooks` (DEPRECATED).

block.description: Plugin Config resources allows configuring plugin definitions. The supported plugins that accept configurations are: `slack`, and `runbooks` (DEPRECATED). Make sure to work with this resource only with the gateway version 1.39.1 and onwards.

config.description: A list of configuration values for the plugin connection. The values depend on the plugin type.

connection_id.description: The unique identifier of the connection.

plugin_name.description: The name of the plugin that this configuration refers to. Accepted values are: `slack`, `webhooks`, `runbooks` (DEPRECATED), `access_control`.

block.description: Plugin Connection resources allows enabling features specific features to connection which are called plugins. The supported plugins are: `slack`, `webhooks`, `runbooks` (DEPRECATED), `access_control`.

git_hook_ttl.description: Git password or token for repository authentication.

git_password.description: Git password or token for repository authentication.

git_url.description: Git repository URL where the runbook is located.

repository.description: The normalized name of the repository. E.g.: 'github.com/hoophq/runbooks'

ssh_key.description: SSH private key for Git repository authentication.

ssh_keypass.description: SSH key passphrase for encrypted SSH keys.

ssh_known_hosts.description: SSH known hosts for host key verification.

ssh_user.description: SSH username for Git repository authentication.

block.description: Manages Runbook Configuration resources. Make sure to work with this resource only with the gateway version 1.47.0 and onwards

connections.description: List of connection names which this rule applies to.

id.description: The unique identifier of the connection resource.

name.description: The relative git path of the runbook file.

repository.description: The normalized name of the repository. E.g.: 'github.com/hoophq/runbooks'

user_groups.description: List of user groups names which this rule applies to.

block.description: Manages Runbook Rules resources. It allows defining which connections and groups could interact with runbooks. Make sure to work with this resource only with the gateway version 1.47.0 and onwards

email.description: The email address of the user.

id.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

status.description: The status of the user. Accepted values are: `active`, `inactive`.

block.description: Manage user and group resources. Do not use this terraform resource when managing groups via Identity Provider. Make sure to work with this resource only with the gateway version 1.39.1 and onwards.
